unit_rules.catalog_class: Behavior family; versions and repairs remain longitudinal, not independent extraction attempts.
unit_rules.mechanism_instance: Pinned donor revision plus behavior plus declared target-host profile; package bytes identify a version within this tuple.
unit_rules.discovery_cell: Frozen source-method-epoch cell; output limits, abstention and proposal rejection are not generated-code failures.
unit_rules.effect_block: Original frozen task population, package versions, protocol and trial reducer; no pooling across blocks.

scope_limitations: Purposive development sample, not a prevalence estimate.
No category frequency, automated extraction success rate or scale-fragility curve is estimated.
Existing independent cases may be reused regression checks; fixture evidence is not a benchmark score.
Current capacity scoring is excluded until the original full release.
Candidate-level repair does not retrospectively change the original outcome.

fields.source_preconditions: An actual base-PASSED inventory and tests that can be related to the candidate snapshot.
fields.actual_consumer: Source regression selection/reranking; in the target, the next solver request and, in the historical GP block, the candidate selector.
fields.dependencies: Native-log parsing, frozen preservation obligations, snapshot identity, isolated execution and original-test projection.
fields.host_mapping: Offline regression evidence becomes in-loop checking and delivered feedback. Complete inventory, three-state obligations and native syntax are declared adaptations.
fields.observed_boundary: Historical GP projection erased test-only candidate differences. Complete preservation receipts did not assert issue repair. The model's source metadata was invalid; independent source review supplied traceability.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: A model repaired only native_logs.py; inherited modules were unchanged. Public 31/31, reused regression 8/8 and the same-package recorded entry passed. A GP path with one candidate solved its task; selector increment was unmeasured.

catalog_cases.target_host_profile: r_full_package_v1 effect grammar; r_behavior_transfer_v1 complete-script contract; r_behavior_api_v1 prompt adaptation

fields.source_preconditions: An issue behavior that can be exercised through the required public operation chain; a generated script must meet base-admission conditions.
fields.actual_consumer: Source reproduction execution/reranking; target solver feedback and candidate checking in RP.
fields.dependencies: Source context, generation prompts, script extraction, observable assertions, isolated execution, frozen scripts and snapshot-bound receipts.
fields.host_mapping: Prepare, execute on base, admit, freeze and recheck. API operations, observed results and assertions are explicit target adaptations.
fields.observed_boundary: The current R/RP block admitted no reproducer in eight relevant paths. Some SIGKILL causes remain UNKNOWN. Older R versions and their scores are separate.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: The current package passed public 8/8 and reused independent 22/22. A same-fixture generated checker accepted the complete repair and rejected two shallow repairs; this is exposed development evidence.

catalog_cases.behavior: Context removal, duplicate bookkeeping and feedback

fields.source_preconditions: Known FileContext members and ordered removal requests, including repeated keys.
fields.actual_consumer: Source CleanupContext Observation; target ModelView and the next solver request.
fields.dependencies: Membership state, deletion bookkeeping and feedback; target observation identities, selection policy and pressure threshold.
fields.host_mapping: File keys become eligible observation IDs. The package requests projection and the host delivers it. The selector and pressure policy are adaptations, not donor-provided generic compression.
fields.observed_boundary: All 30 recorded replacements were delivered, but there were zero input readmissions. Deleted content was sometimes read again; logs with an outer zero exit code could contain failures. No causal score loss is identified.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: Both implementations passed public 9/9 and independent 6/6; the accepted unchanged package passed ordinary and one-request-left entries. Two implementations count as one class.

catalog_cases.behavior: Rolling summary of completed history groups

fields.source_preconditions: A history threshold, completed interaction groups, prior summary and identifiable replaceable history.
fields.actual_consumer: Source ConversationMemory and CodeActAgent.step; target next solver request.
fields.dependencies: Grouping, prior summary, original summarization prompt, model request, projection, delivery acknowledgment and shared budget.
fields.host_mapping: Source events become complete interaction groups with disclosed 16/1/10000 settings. The authoritative history remains intact; only the model view is projected.
fields.observed_boundary: A separate Direct package supplied null instructions where the runner required a string; the frozen profile omitted that explicit type. The accepted A2S package did not have this failure. The GS effect block was interrupted.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: The accepted package passed public 5/5, independent 5/5 and the recorded entry. Repeated summarization and skipping when insufficient requests remain were exercised; benchmark benefit remains TBD.

catalog_cases.behavior: Patch construction, admission, normalization and selection

fields.source_preconditions: Declared nonempty Python files, original same-base text, bounded candidate pool and source parsing/admission/normalization rules.
fields.actual_consumer: Source repair/postprocess/reranking; target publishes the original candidate snapshot selected by the package.
fields.dependencies: Prompt and parser, candidate identity, admission, normalization, voting and first-occurrence tie-break. The host executes model requests and materializes candidates.
fields.host_mapping: Four same-base callbacks; full-file intervals and declared paths replace the donor wrapper's eval. Special ellipsis forms are outside the domain. Only prompt/parser replace the predecessor's slots.
fields.observed_boundary: The accepted SEARCH/REPLACE package admitted 48/48 candidates but tied N at 6/12. The historical GP selector's RAW fallback/tie-break and the fresh source-access package's donor-detail failures belong to different packages.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: Current public 4/4, corrected independent 5/5 and same-package entry passed. An initial separate four-task block measured 4/4 versus N 1/4; the twelve-task host advantage did not recur.

fields.source_preconditions: Completed tool results with a source failure condition and visible error details.
fields.actual_consumer: BaseAgent reflection enters the next conversation turn; target feedback is delivered to the next solver request.
fields.dependencies: Failure predicate, error carrier and fixed advice; host action events, message identity and delivery state.
fields.host_mapping: Assistant reflection becomes a user observation; multi-result handling becomes per-action handling under the host's bounded error-detail domain.
fields.observed_boundary: The default TraeAgent override disables the BaseAgent behavior. The ordinary host already provides the same error; the additional content is fixed advice. This class has no benchmark score.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: The model-selected target after same-source development passed public 6/6 and independent 6/6; failure feedback was delivered and acknowledged while successes remained silent.

catalog_cases.behavior: Hierarchical localization, without the older first-repair stage

fields.source_preconditions: Issue text, repository structure and readable source; file/symbol/line responses must be parsed.
fields.actual_consumer: Source repair stage; target ordinary solver continuation or the LP editing pool.
fields.dependencies: Generated controller, inherited donor helper, staged model requests, source reads, range parsing and handoff.
fields.host_mapping: Localization returns immutable file/range context and the remaining shared budget. The current package does not perform the older L version's first repair.
fields.observed_boundary: A predecessor applied a 256-byte identifier bound to issue text with a 100000-byte public limit, stopping an unscored block. This is a concrete implementation defect, not evidence of intrinsic inseparability.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: A model changed one issue predicate/call site; helper bytes and other AST nodes were unchanged. New public boundary 2/2, independent boundary 8/8 and recorded L/LP entries passed. These are not full-domain requalification.

catalog_cases.behavior: Independent model choice among candidate snapshots

fields.source_preconditions: Bounded candidates, submitted state and matching source/hunk context; source preselection disabled.
fields.actual_consumer: Source reviewer selection; target publishes the selected original complete snapshot.
fields.dependencies: Submitted filter, PatchFormatter and template, separate model request, trailing-number parser, fallback and identity cache.
fields.host_mapping: At most four candidates; JSON snapshot/hunk metadata substitutes for environment reads. Noncompleted choice requests become UNAVAILABLE.
fields.observed_boundary: After a template repair, the independent stager's directory permissions caused all 20 cases to fail before package import. This was an evaluation infrastructure fault, not 20 mechanism failures.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: The same package passed public 12/12 and, after staging repair, reused independent 20/20 cases and 78/78 steps. Its actual entry passed. Changed selected trees did not establish a score gain; unselected candidates were not all scored.

fields.source_preconditions: Completed nonempty architect text, inheritable file/read-only context and remaining editor budget.
fields.actual_consumer: Source ArchitectCoder.reply_completed creates an editor; target ordinary A editor or AP SEARCH/REPLACE editor.
fields.dependencies: Original prompt/text, empty editor history, inherited files, editor settings and usage/budget accounting.
fields.host_mapping: The ordinary host or unchanged SEARCH/REPLACE package replaces the Aider editor. AP places the complete architect advice in the editing issue field. This is not complete Aider.
fields.observed_boundary: An initial host bridge prepended context and shifted registered tool-observation indices. The delivery check caught it; the package was unchanged. Four-task composition did not exceed its best single component.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: Preserving existing observation indices repaired the bridge; both A/AP entries passed. Public 5/5 and independent 8/8 passed. N/A/P/AP solved 2/3/3/3 tasks in its own four-task block.

fields.source_preconditions: Older observations exceed a threshold and already have typed summaries; the last executed node remains complete.
fields.actual_consumer: ActionAgent passes MessageHistoryGenerator output to completion_model.create_completion.
fields.dependencies: ViewCode/RunTests summary producers, node/action pairing, file/test state and threshold configuration.
fields.host_mapping: Generic shell observations would require equivalent typed producers or a separately declared new summarizer.
fields.observed_boundary: The selector alone is not a complete donor-derived generic shell summarizer. The proposed control cases in the source review were not executed.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: The source path really does feed the model. A separate Moatless cleanup package was accepted under explicit observation-projection adaptations; it is a different mechanism.

source_boundary_cases.evidence_type: reported donor calibration plus separate static consumer tracing

fields.source_preconditions: Step text and tool-call metadata; tag extraction assumes a valid match.
fields.actual_consumer: SimpleCLIConsole renders LakeView descriptions/tags in a Panel; this path does not replace solver history.
fields.dependencies: Description/tag prompts, regex match and display callback. _agent_step_str does not consume tool-result bodies.
fields.host_mapping: Using these annotations as a solver-facing compressor would add new input selection, trigger and consumer behavior.
fields.observed_boundary: Two discovery cards promised malformed-tag retry, but the donor raised IndexError. Separately, the static source review found a UI consumer rather than the intended model-context consumer.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: A different BaseAgent tool-failure reflection target from the same donor was accepted as catalog F. This does not repair or validate either LakeView card.

source_boundary_cases.evidence_type: reported donor execution and reference-discrimination failure

fields.source_preconditions: FileContext membership and removal/accounting behavior in the submitted card.
fields.actual_consumer: Cleanup feedback in the donor; the candidate's declared evaluator observed effects only.
fields.dependencies: Internal accounting state and whether the contract requires exposing it.
fields.host_mapping: The original card permitted state-only accounting and optional output; its evaluator could not observe the required difference.
fields.observed_boundary: Correct and incorrect internal accounting were indistinguishable to effects-only acceptance. This stopped reference calibration, not generated-code testing.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: A later given-target C transfer used an explicitly observable mapping and was accepted. It is a new contract/profile, not a retroactive success for the discovery card.

source_boundary_cases.evidence_type: four original-donor cases and an actual-host-class mapping witness; no generated target execution

fields.source_preconditions: Tool-result messages grouped into interactions and a defined configurable keep_iterations value.
fields.actual_consumer: The AHE compaction path; proposed target ModelView projection for subsequent solver input. Generated-target consumption was not reached.
fields.dependencies: NexAU message types/Pydantic, AHE ToolResultCompaction, retention configuration, observation ownership and origin_query mapping.
fields.host_mapping: The original card selected only package-owned observations; the actual entry initially supplied host-owned observations. Projection preserves ownership and cannot create the required population.
fields.observed_boundary: Four donor cases supported O1/O2, but the initial target eligibility was unreachable. A later card selected host observations yet omitted the configuration source/initialization. Both stopped before code generation.
fields.counterexample_or_repair: The real host can project host-owned observations; ownership is not a general host limitation. The continuation repaired that restriction only. A complete accepted mapping/package remains UNKNOWN.
